title: A room id holding a NUL character is refused by create_room with a value error, before anything is written
notes: create_room refuses room\u0000one: no room is created, and no framework event names it. The steps neither read such an id from the store nor route a message to one, since not every store can hold or look up an id with a NUL character. Not observed: the taking of a room's lock refusing such an id that came from elsewhere (a room written to the store straight, a router's answer), before the lock manager is asked.
